# Compiler math mappings

120 mapped f32/f64 libm exports, plus core-only compiler routes.

The same shard generates compiler dispatch, placeholder constants, symbol lookup,
operand counts, cmath interception, and libdevice link requirements. Handwritten
semantic expansions remain responsible for sincos, frexp, modf, remquo, lgamma_r, legacy min/max, C23 min/max, j1 infinity correction, and fast binops.

Libdevice bitcode SHA-256: `91334d6e12748f6cb5bbf0a1cd965a56bcd93dc4f496d2e5c5f8c6e523094356`.

`libnvvm` links only on that backend; `always` links on both; `never` uses
a handwritten expansion. Aliases are separate exports sharing a mapping.
